phases.name: Financial System
phases.notes: COMPLETE (2026-09-21) — CoreGrid's Payment, Billing & Financial Operating System (the registry label stays short; the document and acceptance record carry the full identity). Domain-neutral by construction: the debtor and the beneficiary are identity references, and charge reasons, tax rules, calendars, discount categories and provider choices are institutional data, so an education provider, a health provider, a logistics operator, a warehouse operator, a public agency and a marketplace configure the same engine in their own vocabulary rather than forking it. New this phase — financial-splits (immutable splits whose legs sum exactly to the gross, per-leg settlement on real evidence, provider fees attributed to the leg that produced them, pro-rata refunds with a deterministic remainder that never returns more from a beneficiary than it received, unresolved legs kept visible, and the platform's own fee modelled as a leg like any other), financial-routing (provider neutrality as a decision over declared capabilities, where capability dominates preference, unroutable requirements are reported, and failover is refused after a success, after an unresolved timeout and without proof of no capture), financial-journal (append-only events with contiguous sequence, causation and correlation; a transactional outbox; reconstruction of money state from events with a disagreeing cache reported rather than preferred; double-entry-compatible postings refused when they do not balance) and financial-tax (versioned rules resolved by jurisdiction, category and instant, where an undeclared jurisdiction is unknown rather than zero and inclusive/exclusive pricing is computed in exact minor units). Document completed 14/20 to 20/20 by addenda EJ domain neutrality, EK provider neutrality and split payments, EL command model, EM query model, EN data model, EO dependency model and EP financial memory and knowledge model. Contract extended to nine suites and nine provided capabilities; surface /super-admin/financial-operations renders every executed check with its observation, the rules with their modules and blueprint sections, six organizations' vocabulary and the declared gaps, with no role list. Acceptance: architecture/phase-acceptance/phase-13-financial-system.json (24 areas — ENFORCED 16 / DECLARED 8 / UNWIRED 0 / MISSING 0). Declared and unproven: no live provider adapter, no persistence migration, no reconciliation run over a provider statement, no collections or dispute state machines, no metered usage or renewal generation, no asynchronous financial jobs, and no authorised ingestion boundary — so no platform surface calls these engines yet. Record: architecture/archaeology/phase-13-financial-system.audit.md
